For decades, KLA has worked at the leading edge of deep science , taking on complex technical challenges that often take years to solve. By combining expertise in optics, sensors, machine learning, data analytics, and software engineering, KLA helps enable the ideas and devices that transform the future of technology. At KLA, innovation is driven by a belief that precision matters at the smallest scale —from nanometer‑level measurement to world‑class manufacturing quality. Our solutions support advanced manufacturing across wafers, integrated circuits, packaging, and printed circuit boards, making everyday technologies such as smartphones, data centers, autonomous systems, and connected devices possible. ICOS products operate at the intersection of optics, mechanics, electronics, and software , making them inherently complex and quality‑sensitive. The division’s success depends not only on innovation in inspection capability, but also on robust system validation, safe operation, and predictable software behavior across diverse customer environments . Strong initiative, fast learning ability, proactive attitude, and excellent team spirit.
